# 1.37.0-beta.2

Second beta of 1.37.0: the agent and the chat.

## Agent browser

- The agent has its own web browser: a separate window on this PC with its own profile and sign-ins, separate from your Edge. It opens sites, reads pages, clicks, fills in and sends forms through the page itself, which is far more reliable than the mouse on huge web pages.
- The agent never types passwords. When a site needs a sign-in or a check, the browser window shows what to do and a Done button.
- Files a page downloads go to Downloads through the same download allowlist as before.
- Turn it on in Settings > Security. It is off by default and never arrives from a data archive.

## Chat

- Temporary chat: in an empty chat, switch on Temporary chat in the middle. Such a chat is never saved to disk, never appears in search, archives or backups. Settings > Security > Privacy decides whether it lives until the app closes or disappears as soon as you leave it.
- Branch into a new chat: a new button under every answer starts a new chat with the conversation up to that answer.
- The Export the conversation up to here icon is now the same size as its neighbours.
- The chat can write to agents from earlier answers, not only the current one. Settings > Models > Agent sets how long: until the answer ends, while the app is open, or saved in the chat.

## Models

- Speed for models that have it: Economy (Flex), Standard, Fast and Ultrafast for OpenAI, fast mode for Claude Opus 5, 5.5 and 4.8, and the same tiers through OpenRouter. It is next to the reasoning level, per chat and per slot. Estimated prices follow the tier the answer was actually served at.
- OpenRouter privacy: Settings > Security > Privacy > Only providers that keep no data sends every OpenRouter request only to providers that neither store it nor train on it. With it on, batch models skip the batch queue, since the queue keeps requests for up to 30 days.

## Downloads

- The download allowlist can be switched off: Settings > Security > Download sources > Download from any site. The list stays and works again as soon as you switch it back.
